## Scripts
- [Citrix Profile Management Log Analyzer](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//script-library-posts/citrix-profile-management-log-analyzer/): Checks that Citrix Profile Management logging is enabled and reads the log file, filtered to the specific user session for that machine\.
- [FSLogix \- Logoff sessions with loaded profiles](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//script-library-posts/fslogix-logoff-sessions-with-loaded-profiles/): To be used with the ControlUp FSLogix Event Trigger to determine which session to log off to release the lock on a FSLogix container
- [Store CU Streaming DB Credentials for CU Scripts](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//script-library-posts/store-cu-streaming-db-credentials-for-cu-scripts/): Create the credential files \(on a ControlUp Monitor machine\) required by script actions that use the ControlUp Streaming Database\.\_x000A\_Stored in %ALLUSERSPROFILE%ControlUpScriptingSupport but the API key stored in the files can only be decrypted by the Windows user that created that file\.\_x000A\_This script should be run on the same machine and as the same Windows user that will run the scripts that interact with the ControlUp Streaming DB\.\_x000A\_The script will overwrite any existing CU API key for the user\.
- [ControlUp Disk Monitor Log Analyzer 7 Days](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//script-library-posts/controlup-disk-monitor-log-analyzer-7-days/): This script will analyze the log  files of last 7 days created by ControlUp Disk Monitor and created a CSV output
- [ControlUp Disk Monitor Log Analyzer 24 Hours](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//script-library-posts/controlup-disk-monitor-log-analyzer-24-hours/): This script will analyze the log  file of today created by ControlUp Disk Monitor and created a CSV output

## Blog posts
- [Join Us for 2 Days of Learning, Networking, and Innovation at the AVD Tech Fest](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//blog/join-us-for-2-days-of-learning-networking-and-innovation-at-the-avd-tech-fest/)

- [ControlUp's Response to the CrowdStrike's Global Outage](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//blog/controlups-response-to-the-crowdstrikes-global-outage/)
- [5 Must\-See Demos at Microsoft Ignite 2025](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//blog/5-must-see-demos-at-microsoft-ignite-2025/)

## Events
- [Beyond Experience: Virtual Event \- Australia](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//resources/events/beyond-experience-virtual-event-australia/): One hour, wherever you are\. See how DEX, agentic AI, and Autonomous Endpoint Management are reshaping IT operations \- with IT staying firmly in control\.

- [EUC Sweden Kofenrens 2026](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//resources/events/euc-sweden-kofenrens-2026/): I 17 år har EUC Sweden varit Sveriges naturliga mötesplats för Modern End User Computing\. Här möts IT\-specialister, offentlig sektor, MSP:er och branschens ledande leverantörer för två dagar fyllda av kunskap, inspiration och värdefulla kontakter\.
- [OUTCOME 2026: Brisbane](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//resources/events/outcome-2026-brisbane/): Join blueAPACHE and our technology partners at events, webinars, roundtables and industry sessions designed to help organisations navigate change, explore emerging technologies and make informed decisions with confidence\.
- [It\-sa 2026](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//resources/events/it-sa-2026/): Find out everything you need to know about Europe’s leading trade fair for IT security and meet the community in person at the Nuremberg Exhibition Centre\!
- [CANCOM Live 2026 Vorarlberg](https://cupstaging.wpengine.com//resources/events/cancom-live-2026-vorarlberg/): Im Herbst 2026 veranstalten wir zum wiederholten Male unsere DACH\-weite erfolgreiche Eventserie CANCOM LIVE in Österreich\.
